data.narrative:
44.01 is a Series A–stage climate and energy company that has raised $37M to date. The relevant comparable universe consists of one public company (Linzatech, ticker LNZA) and eight private peers operating in climate and energy, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, and KoBold Metals. However, narrow peer matching—filtering for same or adjacent stage and similar valuation tier—yielded insufficient datapoints to support a median-based valuation.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using the $37M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to later-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $74M. This reflects a conservative assumption that capital deployed to date is broadly representative of the company's current enterprise value, adjusted for expected value creation and dilution through the next financing round.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $63M to $85M, centered on $74M. The primary constraint is the absence of sufficiently close peers in stage and scale; a richer comparable set in climate-tech at the Series A / B boundary would improve confidence. Key uncertainties include unit economics validation, path to cash-flow positivity, and competitive positioning within the crowded climate-tech landscape. Investors should view this range as provisional pending additional operational milestones or market-comparable data.
